categories.main_business_segments: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited (CRCHI) primarily operates in three main business segments: tunnel boring machines (TBM), rail transit equipment, and special professional equipment. The company designs, develops, manufactures, sells, leases, and services high-end equipment for underground engineering, rail transit, mining, and agricultural machinery. Its product portfolio includes various types of TBMs, railway turnouts, fasteners, tunnel construction robots, mining equipment, and high-end agricultural machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CRCHI emphasizes innovation-driven development with proprietary technologies in tunnel boring machines, including large-diameter and variable-diameter TBMs, and intelligent construction equipment. The company integrates digital twin systems, intelligent manufacturing, and automation technologies such as 5G, industrial internet, and AI to enhance product design, manufacturing, and service. It has developed key components like large-diameter main bearings, hydraulic pumps, and control systems, achieving breakthroughs in hard rock excavation, non-explosive tunneling, and intelligent robotic construction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are large infrastructure construction enterprises, including central enterprises, state-owned enterprises, and listed companies in railway, urban rail transit, mining, water conservancy, and hydropower sectors. Major projects include high-speed railways, metro lines, mining operations, and water resource projects both domestically and internationally. The company also serves overseas markets, especially Belt and Road countries, with customized solutions for complex underground and rail transit projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: CRCHI operates extensively across China, with key facilities and subsidiaries in Hunan, Sichuan, Xinjiang, Guangdong, Jilin, Inner Mongolia, and other provinces. It has established 10 overseas regional business departments covering 184 countries and regions, with significant contract growth in countries like Thailand, South Africa, Italy, Saudi Arabia, and others. The company actively expands its global footprint, focusing on localized operations and brand building in international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: CRCHI operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and servicing of specialized heavy equipment for underground engineering and rail transit. It acts as a supply chain leader in tunnel equipment, integrating upstream component manufacturing with downstream project delivery and after-sales services. The company also manages strategic supplier alliances and pursues localization of critical components to enhance supply chain resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on innovation-driven growth, emphasizing differentiation, intelligence, and globalization. It invests heavily in R&D (8.79% of revenue in 2023), targeting breakthroughs in core technologies such as large-diameter TBM components, intelligent robotic construction, and digital twin platforms. CRCHI pursues integration of cutting-edge technologies like AI, 5G, and industrial internet to enable smart manufacturing and service digitalization. It also advances sustainable development through green technologies and low-carbon product innovations.
categories.revenue_model: CRCHI generates revenue primarily through the sale of high-end equipment including tunnel boring machines, rail transit components, and special professional machinery. It also earns income from equipment leasing services, particularly for TBMs and specialized equipment. Additional revenue streams include after-sales services, technical support, and integrated project solutions. The company’s sales are predominantly direct to end customers domestically, with a mix of direct sales and agency partnerships in overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CRCHI is a global leader in underground engineering equipment and rail transit manufacturing, consistently ranking among the top 50 global engineering machinery manufacturers. It holds leading market shares in China for rock tunnel boring machines (approx. 56%) and large-diameter shield machines (approx. 37%). The company’s products have won multiple national manufacturing champion titles. It competes with international heavy equipment manufacturers but distinguishes itself through high customization, advanced technology, and comprehensive lifecycle services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, CRCHI reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 10.03 billion, a slight decrease of 0.73% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.59 billion, down 13.59%. Total assets reached RMB 25.44 billion, with net assets of RMB 16.53 billion, reflecting steady growth. The company maintains strong R&D investment and has a stable contract backlog with new contract signings growing by 1.48%. Overseas contracts grew significantly by 52.64%, indicating robust international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CRCHI emphasizes its unique value proposition of delivering highly customized, technologically advanced, and intelligent underground and rail transit equipment. Its products address complex and challenging construction environments with superior safety, efficiency, and environmental performance. The company’s integration of digital twin technology, intelligent manufacturing, and full lifecycle services differentiates it from competitors. It also highlights its role as a national champion in manufacturing critical components and its commitment to sustainable, green development.
